text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер is pessimistic about her
debut race,
believing she's not good
enough to compete.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After waving off my attempts to
motivate her by
telling her to show the
crowd what she's made of,
she makes her
way out to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
